listings.text: Events FAQ About Contact Sign in 0 ICB Productions' Summer Lovin' Singing through all the summer feels About the Show Summer Lovin', is a cabaret featuring music of all genres, as we sing through the many feelings of summer. From fun in the sun, to endings and goodbyes, and more. The cabaret will feature a diverse group of performers from various backgrounds, all centered around themes, emotions, and events of summer. We can't wait to have the fun in the sun with you at TGR42 on August 11th, 9:30pm! Genre Variety Shows Duration 75 minutes Age Restriction All ages Behind the Act: Isabella Borte Ani Chong 570 Tenth Avenue New York, NY 10036 View on map Show Disclaimer/Terms All Sales are Final. Behind the Act ISABELLA BORTE Isabella Concetta Borte (Director/Producer) - Isabella Concetta Borte (she/her) is the Founder/Artistic Director of ICB Productions, and so grateful to be embarking on this journey. She is from Syracuse, NY and is currently a student at Drew University majoring in Theatre Performance and Directing/Stage Management, and minoring in Musical Theatre, Dance, Performing Arts Administration, and Applied Performance/Community Engagement for Theatre.  She currently works for the Joffrey Ballet School as an Administrative Assistant. She has well rounded experience in theatre and dance performance, stage management, directing, producing, scenic & props design, sound mixing, choreography, production management/assistance, and more. She also plays on the NCAA Golf team at Drew! She made her TGR42 Debut on Halloween 2025, in "Ghouls Just Wanna Have Fun!" produced by Moore Productions. Some of her most recent credits include “The Secret Garden” (Swing/Choreographer) at Trilogy Repertory, The Startup Off - Broadway (Associate Producer and Marketing Assistant) at The Flea Theater, Jean Doumanian Productions (Intern) in NYC, “You’re a Good Man Charlie Brown” (Sally Brown) at Drew University, “Heirloom” (Assistant Stage Manager) at Drew University, “Freeform: The Architecture of Movement” (Choreographer) at Drew University, “Frozen Jr. “ (Production Assistant) at Sellwood Studio of Performing Arts, “Legally Blonde” (Production Assistant) at Spotlight Kids Company, and “Rising Rivers” and "Sing it Forward" (Lead Producer), “Defying Sanity”, and “Speaking Out, Singing Louder”, all at 54 Below. Read more ANI CHONG Ani Chong (Music Director) - Ani Chong is an NYC-based Music Director and pianist. She just graduated NYU Steinhardt in the Spring. Ani has worked on various musical theatre productions around NYC while pursuing her classical training. She has previously music directed "Sing it Forward" at 54 Below, as well as the Off-Broadway premiere of "A Pirate’s Life". Ani is absolutely thrilled to be working with a wonderful team of people on this show! listings.text: Log in / Sign up The Golden Hour Series at Greely Square: Gogo Norales by Jalopy Theatre Follow The Golden Hour Series at Greely Square: Gogo Norales Thu, 13 Aug 2026 7:00 - 8:30 PM (EDT) Greeley Square Park Between 32nd and 33rd Streets, Broadway and, 6th Ave, New York, New York Share THIS IS AN OFFSITE EVENT 7-8:30pm, Free! The Golden Hour Series is a sunset music festival in Greeley Square featuring Americana, jazz, and emerging indie acts. Curated by keystone cultural partners including The New Colossus Festival, Jalopy Theatre, The Jazz Gallery, Sofar Sounds and Manhattan School of Music. Gogo Norales is a 23-year-old Garifuna World Music and folkloric musician based in New York. Along with his band, he performs and presents Garifuna music from Honduras, representing the Garifuna communities of Belize, Honduras, Guatemala, and Nicaragua. Deeply committed to the belief that culture is identity, Gogo has gained popularity by proudly advocating for Garifuna heritage. In 2024, he performed at several major events, including the Multicultural Festival, the Latin TV & Film Festival, Fête de la Musique, and the Car Free Festival. His 2025 schedule remains active, including advocacy for an Earth Day festival and sponsorship for a new bookstore in the Bronx. Gogo's work is featured in a compilation produced by Tito Pingolinis and on an album with artist Andy Ordonez. Beyond his music, Gogo is a humanitarian dedicated to mentoring youth and promoting his culture internationally, specifically in Honduras and St. Vincent and the Grenadines. He aims to inspire children to embrace their cultural identities. His performances have been featured on Telemundo, Latin TV & Film networks, Univision, BronxNet, and ABCNYC. Gogo’s debut EP is scheduled for release this April and will be available on all music platforms. New Tricks Stories is an exciting storytelling show where all the storytellers are of a “certain age.” With awarding -winning performers from RISK!, PBS’ Stories From The Stage , Story Collider, The Moth and more! Brilliant storytellers over forty tell stories with life experience, resilience, and the humor and heartbreak that come with time. Laugh, cry, wonder what it was like to use a dial phone, and grab a drink while you listen to marvelous tales from voices that come with decades of living.
